title: Fix tests/test_node.py import of nonexistent PEER_DB_MAX_SIZE from lichen.node
description: python/tests/test_node.py:49 imports PEER_DB_MAX_SIZE from lichen.node, but the symbol does not exist in python/src/lichen/node.py. Entire module fails pytest collection, which blocks any repo-wide 'pytest -k' run (discovered 2026-08-27 while running the W2-CHANNEL gate: 'pytest tests -k channel or medium or rendezvous' aborted with 1 collection error). Either re-add the constant or update the test to the current peer-db API. Unrelated to the vhvj hop-channel cluster; pre-existing on the working tree before W2-CHANNEL edits.
